# Fixture policy

Binary fixtures must be generated by a checked-in deterministic recipe or come from an explicitly
redistributable public source. Each manifest record includes path, format, purpose, origin,
recipe/source, license, redistribution eligibility, SHA-256, and security classification.
Unregistered documents, hash drift, and unclear redistribution rights fail validation.

DOCX fixtures are original Elftia-authored artifacts. Their checked-in case matrix separates
malformed/unsafe containers, which are rejected even by inert inspection, from active-content
packages, which may only be inventoried under the non-mutating `preserve-disabled` policy.
